title: Here’s How to Watch ‘The Dropout’ Online for Free
summary: Before you watch documentary You Can See Everything, stream the 2022 series The Dropout starring Amanda Seyfried.
contentText:

Although it was released in 2022, the series The Dropout is having a bit of a pop culture moment in 2026, thanks to the new Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim documentary You Can See Everything . The documentary follows one month before Theranos CEO Elizabeth Holmes is sent to federal prison for wire fraud, as the directors have unlimited access to her and her family.

Watch on Disney+

The Dropout serves as a companion piece to You Can See Everything because the series is referenced multiple times throughout the film, while it’s also intertwined with Holmes’ story in the lead up to her life behind bars. Starring Amanda Seyfried , The Dropout is available to stream with Hulu on Disney+ .

How to Watch ‘The Dropout’ Online, At a Glance:

- No. of Episodes: 8

- Network: Hulu

- Online Streaming: Hulu + Live TV , Hulu on Disney+

How to Watch ‘The Dropout’ Online for Free

'The Dropout'

Get Disney+

Get Disney+ and Hulu plans starting at $12.99 per month.

Disney+ plans start at $12.49 per month for the ad-supported plan, while you can go ad free for $21.49 per month. For even more content, Disney+ offers a bundle with Disney+ and Hulu, which starts at $12.99 per month. You can add ESPN Unlimited to Disney+ and Hulu starting at $35.99 per month.

The streaming bundle has a library of music programming and live concert series, such as Taylor Swift: The Eras Tour , Billie Eilish: Happier Than Ever , Elton John: Goodbye Yellow Brick Road , The Beatles: Get Back and others.

Meanwhile, if you’re not into ESPN Unlimited, you can add HBO Max to Disney+ and Hulu instead with prices starting at $21.99 per month. Unfortunately, there’s no free trial available for either Hulu or Disney+. However, there’s a clever workaround to watch both streaming services for free.

Hulu + Live TV

Get 3-day free trial

Comes with Hulu, Disney+ and ESPN Unlimited.

Created by Elizabeth Meriwether and based on the ABC News podcast of the same name, The Dropout follows the story of Elizabeth Holmes (Amanda Seyfried), a Stanford student who went from dropout to the toast of Silicon Valley as the CEO of the healthcare company Theranos and the revelation of its dubious blood-testing device.

It also stars Naveen Andrews, Elizabeth Marvel, Michel Gill, William H. Macy, Mary Lynn Rajskub, Bill Irwin, Utkarsh Ambudkar, Laurie Metcalf, Stephen Fry and others. Anne Nikitin composed the music score to the Hulu series.
